versions.changelog: 1. Standardize model and output paths: models now live under ~/.cache/huggingface/modules/camera-yolo-operator, outputs under ~/.openclaw/workspace/projects/camera-yolo-operator, and the skill folder stays code-only. 统一模型与输出路径：模型放 modules 缓存，运行结果放 projects，技能文件夹仅保留代码。 2. Refresh the bilingual ClawHub Summary and default script paths for cleaner publishing and runtime behavior. 更新双语 ClawHub Summary 与脚本默认路径，提升发布与运行目录规范性。

Add generic object tracking mode (mode 4) with ByteTrack + Supervision. Support --track for trajectory lines, --output-video for annotated video export, unique object count statistics (deduplicated), and fix output video naming. Mode order corrected. 通用目标轨迹跟踪模式，支持 --track 轨迹线、--output-video 导出标注视频、独立目标数量统计，修正输出文件命名。

Major portability improvements. Models now bundled in skill's models/ folder for zero-config deployment. Output files organized under projects/yolo/ directory. Improved cross-platform support with automatic backend detection (V4L2/DSHOW/AVFoundation). Fix: GTX 10xx Pascal GPU now uses float32 instead of float16 for stable operation. Add --depth-scale parameter for depth calibration. Add download_models.sh script and requirements.txt. Complete documentation restructure with deployment guide and platform notes.
Initial release for local webcam capture and YOLO detection on Windows. 首次发布，支持 Windows 本机摄像头抓拍与 YOLO 检测。
